description: Core implementation: (a) per-repo issue_provider override in the squad model, (b) squads_dir support in the deployment config loader with squad_config kept as fallback, and (c) wire the single-flow engine to resolve the provider per repo via squad.issue_provider_for(repo). This is one cohesive unit because the engine change depends on the new resolver method, and both are exercised by the same integration paths. Includes tests covering PyYAML AND the mini_yaml fallback.
steps: In RepoConfig (frozen, slots dataclass), add field `issue_provider: str | None = None` after auto_merge, with a Portuguese comment '# None = herda do issue_provider raiz da squad'. Update the RepoConfig docstring example to show issue_provider.

In _normalize_repos, when an entry is a dict, parse `issue_provider` (string) if present and pass it to the inline RepoConfig(name=identifier, ...). Only create the inline RepoConfig when at least one of auto_dispatch/auto_merge/issue_provider is set (extend the existing `if auto_dispatch is not None or auto_merge is not None` guard to include issue_provider). Validate that when present it is one of 'github'|'jira', raising SquadConfigError with a clear pt-BR message referencing the source (mirror the root validation at _parse_squad: "issue_provider deve ser 'github' ou 'jira'").

In _parse_repo_configs (the legacy repos_config: block), also parse `issue_provider` per entry with the same github|jira validation, so both inline and legacy forms support it. Keep _merge_repo_configs precedence unchanged (inline repos: wins over repos_config:).

Add method `SquadConfig.issue_provider_for(self, repo: str) -> str` that returns the effective provider: repo override (get_repo_config(repo).issue_provider if not None) else self.issue_provider. Mirror the existing auto_dispatch_for/auto_merge_for docstring style (pt-BR) and note precedence 'config por repo > default da squad'.

Extend the squad-loading blocks in run() (~line 1681) and _run_stage() (~line 3392): after checking `squad_config` (single file), add support for `squads_dir` (a directory). Behavior per the issue: if `squads_dir` is set, call `from flow.config.squad import load_squads_dir` and load all squads from that directory. squad_config (single file) remains a fallback/compat path. Decide the selection order explicitly and document it in a pt-BR comment: prefer squads_dir when set and existing; fall back to squad_config; fall back to inline. When squads_dir yields multiple squads, the deployment currently drives ONE squad per tick/stage — select the squad whose repos/projects intersect the configured `repos`, and if exactly one squad is found use it; document this resolution clearly. If squads_dir is set but does not exist, raise a RuntimeError mirroring the existing squad_config not-found error message (pt-BR).

Update `_resolve_squad_id` (~line 4419) to also honor squads_dir when present (resolve the squad id the same way run() selects the squad), keeping squad_config and squad_id fallbacks intact so the single-flow opens the correct RunLedger DB.

Make _single_flow_tick load the SquadConfig (not just the id) so it can resolve providers per repo. Reuse the same squad-loading logic added in PART B (extract a small helper like `_load_single_flow_squad(cfg)` returning a SquadConfig or None, so run()/_run_stage()/_single_flow_tick share one code path and avoid duplication). Populate global_auto_dispatch/global_auto_merge on it as the existing blocks do if needed.

Change _LedgerStateReader to accept the SquadConfig (or a provider-resolver callable) in addition to a default provider, and in read_state(repo, task_key) resolve the provider via `squad.issue_provider_for(repo)` then `provider_for(that)`; fall back to the default provider when squad is None. Keep the existing implicit_state derivation logic unchanged otherwise.

Change _LedgerDispatcher similarly: in dispatch_stage(repo, issue, stage) and _enrich_issue(repo, issue) resolve the provider via squad.issue_provider_for(repo) when a squad is available, else use the default provider. The dispatch prompt/session logic is unchanged.

In _single_flow_tick, construct the reader/dispatcher with the loaded squad + default root provider (provider_for(cfg['issue_provider'])). Preserve current behavior exactly when no squad or no per-repo override exists (default provider == root).

Extend flow/tests/test_config_squad_workflow.py: (1) inline repos: entry with issue_provider override parses into RepoConfig.issue_provider; (2) issue_provider_for returns the override for that repo and the squad default for a repo without override; (3) invalid per-repo issue_provider (e.g. 'gitlab' or 'azure') raises SquadConfigError; (4) repos_config: legacy form also parses issue_provider. Add at least one test that forces the mini_yaml fallback path (e.g. monkeypatch/hide the `yaml` import or call flow.config.squad._mini_yaml directly on a temp file) to prove the new field parses WITHOUT PyYAML.

Extend flow/tests/test_single_flow_read_state_c3.py (and/or a new test module): assert _LedgerStateReader.read_state uses the per-repo provider — e.g. a squad with root issue_provider=jira and a repo override issue_provider=github causes read_state(that_repo, key) to call the github provider, while another repo uses jira. Use mocks mirroring the existing test style (mock.patch on provider_for and on _collect_implicit_state).

Add/extend a deployment loader test (flow/tests/test_deployment_integration.py or test_stage_entrypoints.py): squads_dir pointing at a temp dir with one squad yaml loads that squad; squad_config still works as before; squads_dir pointing at a non-existent dir raises RuntimeError.
Run `.venv/bin/ruff check .` and fix any style issues; run `.venv/bin/mypy flow deployment` and resolve type errors introduced by the change.
acceptance_criteria: RepoConfig has issue_provider: str | None = None and inline repos: entries + legacy repos_config: entries both parse it.
An invalid per-repo issue_provider raises SquadConfigError with a pt-BR message.
SquadConfig.issue_provider_for(repo) returns the repo override when set, else the squad default, and is covered by tests under BOTH PyYAML and the mini_yaml fallback.
deployment _load_config path supports squads_dir (directory) via load_squads_dir, with squad_config (single file) still working as fallback; a non-existent squads_dir raises RuntimeError.

_single_flow_tick / _LedgerStateReader / _LedgerDispatcher resolve the provider per repo via squad.issue_provider_for(repo); behavior is unchanged when there is no override (default provider still used).
_resolve_squad_id honors squads_dir so the correct RunLedger DB is opened.
New and existing tests pass: `.venv/bin/pytest -q` green; ruff zero warnings; mypy clean.
The mini_yaml fallback parses the new issue_provider field (explicit test).
verification: .venv/bin/mypy flow deployment completes with no new errors
findings: Implemented all parts. PART A: RepoConfig gained issue_provider: str|None=None; _normalize_repos and _parse_repo_configs parse+validate it via new helper _parse_repo_issue_provider (github|jira only, pt-BR error); SquadConfig.issue_provider_for(repo) added (repo override > squad default). PART B: extracted shared _load_single_flow_squad(cfg) + _select_squad_for_repos(squads, repos) in deployment.py; selection order squads_dir(dir) > squad_config(file) > inline; non-existent squads_dir raises RuntimeError('squads_dir ...'); run()/_run_stage() now delegate to the helper. PART B also updated _resolve_squad_id to honor squads_dir. PART C: added _resolve_provider_for_repo helper; _LedgerStateReader/_LedgerDispatcher accept optional squad kwarg and resolve provider per repo via issue_provider_for->provider_for, falling back to default when squad is None; _single_flow_tick loads squad and passes it. Behavior preserved when no squad/override (default==root). PART D: added TestRepoIssueProvider (8 tests incl. _mini_yaml fallback both via _no_pyyaml fixture and direct _mini_yaml call) in test_config_squad_workflow.py; per-repo provider tests in test_single_flow_read_state_c3.py; TestSquadsDirLoader (6 tests) in test_deployment_integration.py. Verification: .venv/bin/pytest flow/tests/ -> 1094 passed, 1 skipped, 1 failed (only the known pre-existing test_template_corrompido_ilegivel_usa_fallback chmod-as-root failure; baseline was 1077 passed, so +17 new tests all green). ruff check flow/ = All checks passed. mypy flow/ --ignore-missing-imports = Success no issues (74 files). Coverage gate: 87.45% >= 75%. Note: RuntimeError for a non-existent squads_dir uses a generic 'deployment:' prefix (not stage-tagged) since it comes from the shared helper; the message still contains 'squads_dir'.
